articles.title: Why Mermaid validation was rejecting valid diagrams - and what fixed it
articles.focus: Walk through the DOMPurify-global-scope bug that made mermaid.parse throw on any diagram with node labels, and the headless-DOM install/restore dance (including saving process and handling getter-only navigator) that makes validateMermaid trustworthy in plain Node.

articles.title: Turning rendered SVG back into Mermaid source - the recovery precedence
articles.focus: Use the five-strategy recovery precedence (script tag, data attributes, pre text, hidden templates, SVG accessibility nodes) as the spine to explain how get-md reverses client-side mermaid.js rendering on GitHub, MkDocs, and Docusaurus pages, and why the strict guard against 'Created with Mermaid' aria-labels matters.

articles.title: Reconstructing diagrams from PDFs by vision model - and the limits we kept
articles.focus: Make the opinionated case for why the PDF vision path is remote-provider-only, capped at 10 pages, and deliberately unhelpful on pure-scan PDFs - arguing that each limit encodes a real tradeoff (context budget, local-llama text-only, empty-result short-circuit) the user should understand before relying on it.
